name: Mythic Great Wyrm Bliss Dragon
body:
MYTHIC GREAT WYRM BLISS DRAGON
CR 29/MR 10

A white soothing aura emanates from the feathered body of this immense, benevolent-looking dragon.

XP 6,553,600
NG Colossal dragon (extraplanar, good, mythic)
Init +12, amazing initiative; Senses dragon senses; Perception +47
Aura frightful presence (360 ft., DC 37)

DEFENSE

AC 54, touch 2, flat-footed 54 (+52 natural, -8 size)
hp 660 (32d12+352+100)
Fort 2920, Will 26; second save
Defensive Abilities draconic fortitude, mythic immortality, mythic sustenance; DR 20/epic and evil; Immune ability damage, ability drain, electricity, paralysis, petrification, sleep; SR 44

OFFENSE

Speed 60 ft., fly 250 ft. (clumsy)
Melee bite +48 (4d8+24), 2 claws +50 (4d6+16/19–20, x3), tail slap +43 (4d6+24), 2 wings +43 (2d8+8)
Space 30 ft.; Reach 20 ft. (30 ft. with bite)
Special Attacks breath weapon (140-ft. line, 24d10 electricity, DC 37), channel positive energy (16d6, DC 37), crush, curse of dampening 3/day (DC 30, mythic magic, mythic power 23/day, peacemaker, pitiful foe 3/day (DC 30), sedating sparks, subduing strikes, surge +1d12, tail sweep
Oracle Spells Known (CL 19th; concentration +30)

9th (5/day)—ascension, overwhelming presence (DC 34)
8th (7/day)—euphoric tranquility (DC 37), holy aura (DC 29), quintessence mastery
7th (8/day)—holy word (DC 28), hymn of peace (DC 32), waves of ecstasy (DC 32)
6th (8/day)—find the path, heal, heroes’ feast
5th (8/day)—dispel evil, life bubble (DC 26), serenity (DC 34), true seeing
4th (8/day)—dismissal (DC 25), freedom of movement, holy smite (DC 25), ride the waves (DC 25)
3rd (9/day)—cure serious wounds, dispel magic, searing light, wind wall
2nd (9/day)—bull’s strength, calm emotions (DC 31), grace, resist energy, status
1st (9/day)—deathwatch, divine favor, remove fear, sanctuary (DC 26), shield of faith
0th (at will)—create water, detect magic, detect poison, guidance, light, mending, resistance, stabilize, vigor

STATISTICS

Str 43, Dex 10, Con 33, Int 26, Wis 27, Cha 32
Base Atk +32; CMB +48; CMD 58
Feats Alertness, Combat Expertise, Critical Focus, Disarming StrikeM, Greater Disarm, Greater Spell Focus (enchantment), Improved Critical M (claw), Improved Disarm, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, PeacemakerM, Persuasive, Self-Sufficient, Sickening Critical, Spell Focus M (enchantment), Weapon Focus M (claw)
Skills Diplomacy +50, Fly +19, Heal +51, Intimidate +50, Knowledge (geography, history, nature, planes, religion) +43, Perception +47, Sense Motive +47, Spellcraft +43, Stealth +19, Survival +47
Languages Celestial, Common, Draconic
SQ aura of refuge, change shape, combat healer, divine countenance, enhanced cures, lay on hands (16d6, 27/day), meditative restoration, merciful, mysterious caster (Succor mystery), planar infusion (360 ft.), shell of succor 3/day (9d6+11 hp), spirit boost (19 hp, 19 rounds)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Aura of Refuge (Su)

Once per day, a juvenile or older mythic bliss dragon can grant fast healing equal to ½ its mythic rank to all creatures within the radius of its planar infusion. This effect lasts for 24 hours. At will, the dragon can also see and hear through any animal or plant present in the area, as the witness spell, except that the mythic bliss dragon doesn’t become blind and deaf when using this ability.

Change Shape (Su)

A bliss dragon can assume any animal form, as beast shape IV.

Channel Positive Energy (Su)

A mythic bliss dragon can spend two uses of its lay on hands ability to channel positive energy as a paladin of a level equivalent to its Hit Dice.

Lay on Hands (Su)

A bliss dragon can use lay on hands as a paladin whose level equals its Hit Dice.

Meditative Restoration (Su)

Once per day as a full-round action, the dragon can affect all adjacent creatures with break enchantment, greater restoration, or resurrection, and can choose a different effect for each creature.

Merciful (Su)

When using lay on hands, the dragon can expend an additional use to apply any paladin mercy of its choice.

Mysterious Caster A young or older mythic bliss dragon is granted revelations as an oracle of its caster level. The dragon can select the Heavens, Life, Nature, or Succor mystery (other mysteries may be available at the GM’s discretion). This counts as two mythic abilities.

Peacemaker (Su)

As a swift action after striking a creature with a claw attack, a bliss dragon can calm that creature, as calm emotions, with the same DC as its frightful presence.

Pristine (Ex)

A bliss dragon is immune to ability damage, ability drain, electricity, and petrification.

Sedating Sparks (Su)

A creature damaged by the dragon’s breath weapon shines with dancing sparks until the start of the dragon’s next turn. A shining creature takes 4d6 points of electricity damage each time it makes an attack.

Subduing Strikes (Ex)

A bliss dragon can choose to deal nonlethal damage with its breath weapon and natural attacks at no penalty.

ECOLOGY

Environment any (Nirvana)
Organization solitary
Treasure triple

Mythic bliss dragons create realms of calm, peace and healing on any plane where they choose to settle, imposing their good will even above planar environments and welcoming any creature searching for rest and respite.
